rationale: Continue the accepted best-effort identity/enrichment strategy with both Tandem Stripe accounts, verified contact-form submissions, and Chaos verified-visitor records. This authorizes read-only aggregate/provider discovery, stable account-scoped external references, bounded first-party attribution/identity observations, independently reviewed implementation, exact release deployment, and live aggregate verification. Stripe is native authority only for its customer/payment/subscription objects; contact forms for the exact submitted identity and entry-page evidence; Chaos only for an already verified visitor/contact mapping and measured attribution. It does not authorize Stripe/payment/customer mutation, contact-form submission or routing mutation, Chaos identity invention from browsing, Party merges, email-based forced joins, customer communication, consent changes, payment/refund/contract action, broad minion access, or changes to checkout recovery, lifecycle, Circle, or legacy receivers.
source_task: Current owner instruction in Codex: add our Stripe accounts, contact-form submissions, and maybe Chaos as additional identity sources, continuing the prior connect-all-best-effort rule.
